description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Wind/Dark, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Estinien] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Estinien
description.text: Increases [Wind/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Wind or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Estinien after using a Dragoon ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Star Diver+
description.text: Six single ranged jump attacks (1.25/1.30 each), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Coerthan Torment+
description.text: Four single ranged jump attacks (1.10 each), grants [Dragoon Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Estinien
description.text: One single ranged jump attack (3.36), grants [Dragoon Instant Cast 3]/[Damage +50% Boost 1] and [Quick Cast 1] if 0-3/4+ FF14 allies are alive

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
